links.outcome: Prospective performance of DL model on live bpMRI data
links.effect: In the prospective cohort, AUC 0.83 (95% CI: 0.77-0.89) for PI-RADS ≥ 3, with 93% sensitivity and 54% specificity.
links.quote: In the prospective cohort, the model achieved an AUC of 0.83 (95% CI: 0.77-0.89) for PI-RADS ≥ 3 classification, with 93% sensitivity and 54% specificity.

unlisted_practices: Using a deep learning model on abbreviated bpMRI to tailor scan protocol, recommending additional mpMRI sequences only when beneficial
Real-time inference at the scanner via an automated MRI workflow

screen.reason: The study develops and prospectively validates a deep learning model integrated at the scanner console to recommend MRI protocol tailoring (bpMRI vs mpMRI), but primarily tests model discrimination and runtime latency without evaluating an organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
